clauses.reason: Records-only commits are exempt from implementation approval ordering, but still obey existing proposal and delivered-commitment predicates.

updates.rationale: Refusing a decidable record violation at the action prevents immutable invalid history without a second rule or a side ledger.
updates.statement: The commit check applies the shared Proposed-decision predicate to the commit and its parent and changed_commitments to delivered packages identified by the registered workspace base. It refuses added or modified Proposed decisions and rewritten delivered commitments before the branch moves, including records-only commits. Unchanged historical proposals and changes to packages first introduced by the workspace remain subject to their existing rules. Final retains the same predicates as a backstop.

decisions.reason: F5 extends the existing same-predicate rule to records: both predicates can be evaluated from immutable commit inputs without validation. Reuse avoids a stricter parallel rule; keep final as the backstop. A separate record-check clause avoids claiming the COMMIT-CHECK-001 amendment owned by M1/M3. Reopen if this requires schema changes or exceeds a small member.

transaction.reason: Apply the owner-approved F5 record predicates
